text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The fulfilling training camp finally reached its final day.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
It was a camp where I could truly feel my daily growth!
I think I grew by about 15 miles, don't you think?♪
choice_data_list: Yeah, both her strength and the beauty of her running are extra-large!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, hearing you say that directly
makes me 7 miles happy♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, don't you think
we could totally nail the Sprinters Stakes too?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, she was originally conditioned for short-distance
in preparation for the Hanshin Cup. But when it comes
to a GⅠ against Senior-class Umamusume..."
choice_data_list: Will I make it in time? It's fifty-fifty...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I see. Even so, once I'm back, I want to get plenty of running in!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After returning to the academy, while monitoring the situation,
we gradually increased the running workload.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
There was a 0.2-mile stretch just now that I'm curious about.
I'm going to run the next lap under the exact same conditions.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gran Alegria is highly motivated,
and fortunately, her "feel" for running
doesn't seem to be impaired at all.
choice_data_list: (Hm...? Is her gait a little off...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I felt that, Gran Alegria came to a halt as well.
She tried to take another step forward, but—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yes? What is it?
choice_data_list: Do your legs or lower back feel off at all?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I think it's probably just a blister on my foot.
It only stung for about 0.1 miles, though—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's just a blister, don't take it lightly.
If it popped, bacterial infection is a real concern.
choice_data_list: Let's have them take a look at you in the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The injury was minor, and she was told to rest for a few days.
We switch our training focus to race analysis.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, 0.875 miles seems like enough for now.
Next, I think I'll do 0.75 miles and 1.25 miles!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: "I'll take this chance to do all my image training at once!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
1.25 miles is 2000m, a medium distance.
Is this a strategy targeting a Triple Crown sweep?
However, considering the earlier injury...
choice_data_list: Challenging middle distance... let's think this through carefully.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: What do you mean... carefully?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah, are you worried about
what happened at the NHK Mile Cup?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"I think it'll be fine! I've built up my physique,
and I'm confident I can hold my own at medium distance now!"
choice_data_list: ...Yeah. But I still can't make up my mind right now.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Then... what about conquering three divisions?
choice_data_list: ...Honestly, I'm hesitant. The risk is just too high.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Conquering three distance categories... is my dream.
I'll see it through and prove that milers are the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"You promised me...
that you'd chase the same dream as me, didn't you!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—On that day, I found a dream in her running.
That hasn't changed even now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want to grant her dream.
I want my master to see her lifelong wish fulfilled, too. But—

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
What is the best future for her...?
I want you to give that some serious thought.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Considering today's injury, the risk of chasing
the Triple Crown across three divisions
is far too great to overlook.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
An injury...? But it only cost me a tenth of a mile.
Thanks to you, Trainer.
choice_data_list: It's not the injury itself I'm worried about, it's your sense of it.
It's not the injury itself I'm worried about, it's how you feel.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right after we switched from the camp menu to endurance running,
I got injured.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She herself didn't notice the anomaly.
Perhaps it was because, just like in the NHK Mile Cup,
she was riding a wave of peak condition.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her intuition is easily swayed by her mental state.
I have to admit, she's still unstable.
choice_data_list: Taking on reckless challenges might throw your instincts off balance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And I might even lose the ability
to get back my feel for running the mile."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When thinking about her future,
I just can't bring myself to let her take that risk.
choice_data_list: Because you're a miler capable of leaving your name in history.
Because you're a miler who can leave your name in history.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: (...The fear from that time...)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
(I thought I was injured.
I felt like everything was broken—and that it was all over.)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: (Trainer is thinking that it could lead to such an outcome...)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
...I want to avoid that happening too.
However...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I don't... want to give up...!
